reviews.text: After a severe case of gastroenteritis, my Nami no longer had the strength to walk. The doctor managed to get her back on track in two days without having to hospitalize her (which would have been extremely stressful). He was very knowledgeable, helpful, and kind.
Competence, simplicity, correctness and availability distinguish this clinic, in my opinion.
Great professional, clear and meticulous, kind and loving assistant, everything you wish for your pet
Dr. Mariani is one of the best professionals I've ever had the pleasure of meeting. He's kind, patient, and transparent. He's definitely my trusted veterinarian!

I took my dog ​​Jane for her first visit with Dr. Mariani after bringing her home from the breeder. The doctor was very thorough and reassured me when we discovered she had been given to me well before she was three months old.
Because she was my first dog, he gave me lots of advice on how to care for her.
From that day on, he became our trusted vet!

Competence, professionalism, and courtesy. I've been fortunate enough to have Dr. Mariani treat Vega for years now. And even when I've recommended him to friends, I've always done so knowingly.
Well done, Dr. Mariani!
Excellent, very thorough, and honest. We appreciated all the advice he offered. Our puppy has found his vet!

We've had a very difficult treatment journey with our cat.
Professionalism, humanity, and kindness are the key words we've used throughout the months of treatment...
A few months have passed, but I remain grateful for the care you've shown us with our Messner.
